QUOTE: The codes are composed by `MBEDTLS_ERROR_ADD(high, low)` (`include/mbedtls/error.h:113`), which calls `mbedtls_error_add()`. That function returns `high + low` and, under `MBEDTLS_TEST_HOOKS`, also calls a test hook.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_ERROR_ADD/mbedtls_error_add as the combiner but never says it captures __FILE__ and __LINE__.
